mapper.select: SELECT t.month, t.type, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN t.result <> 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pass, SUM(CASE WHEN t.result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail FROM ( SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(i.inspect_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(i.inspect_date), 2, '0')) AS month, i.type, i.result FROM mes_inspection i WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.inspect_date >= #{begin} AND i.inspect_date <= #{end} ) t GROUP BY t.month, t.type ORDER BY t.month, t.type

SELECT COALESCE(i.defect_type, 'OTHER') AS defect_type, SUM(i.defect_qty) AS qty, COUNT(*) AS batch_count FROM mes_inspection i WHERE i.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.result = 'FAIL' AND i.inspect_date >= #{begin} AND i.inspect_date <= #{end} GROUP BY COALESCE(i.defect_type, 'OTHER') ORDER BY qty DESC

SELECT pi.id AS plan_item_id, p.name AS plan_name, pi.name AS item_name, pi.unit, m.name AS material_name, COUNT(it.id) AS subgroups FROM qms_inspection_plan_item pi JOIN qms_inspection_plan p ON p.id = pi.plan_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id JOIN qms_inspection_item it ON it.plan_item_id = pi.id AND it.measured IS NOT NULL JOIN mes_inspection i ON i.id = it.inspection_id AND i.status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE pi.method = 'QUANTITATIVE' GROUP BY pi.id, p.name, pi.name, pi.unit, m.name ORDER BY p.name, pi.seq

SELECT i.id AS inspection_id, i.insp_no, i.inspect_date, it.measured FROM qms_inspection_item it JOIN mes_inspection i ON i.id = it.inspection_id WHERE it.plan_item_id = #{planItemId} AND it.measured IS NOT NULL AND i.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND i.inspect_date >= #{begin} AND i.inspect_date <= #{end} ORDER BY i.inspect_date, i.id
